title: a duplicate before review
line: the file's two entries for Thomas Ahearn, both born 2 October 1846, raise a duplicate question on each while neither baseline is reviewed; merging them answers it on both sides, and the merged entry is never counted again

steps.say: nothing reviewed: each entry's plan holds a duplicate question naming the other

expect.why: the duplicate check runs for every person, reviewed or not

steps.say: the owner merges the second entry into the first

expect.why: the question between the two, on either side, is the one the merge answers

steps.say: the kept entry planned again: the merged entry is never counted
